cues.zh: 他本该怎么做，上校？
cues.en: ...should he have, Colonel?

cues.zh: 你这个讨厌的小混蛋。
cues.en: You snotty little bastard.

cues.zh: [Ross] 法官大人，我请求休庭。
cues.en: [Ross] Your Honor, I'd like to ask for a recess.

cues.zh: 法官，我希望得到这个问题的答案。
cues.en: I'd like an answer to the question, Judge.

cues.zh: 法庭将等待一个答复。
cues.en: The court will wait for an answer.

cues.zh: 如果肯德里克中尉下达了命令……说圣地亚哥不许被碰……
cues.en: If Lieutenant Kendrick, gave an order... that Santiago wasn't to be touched...

cues.zh: ……那他为什么还得被调走？
cues.en: ...then why did he have to be transferred?

cues.zh: 上校？
cues.en: Colonel?

cues.zh: 肯德里克中尉下令执行红色代码，不是吗，因为*那*就是您让肯德里克中尉做的！
cues.en: Lt. Kendrick ordered the code red, didn't he, because *that's* what you told Lt. Kendrick to do!

cues.zh: [Ross] 反对！
cues.en: [Ross] Object!

cues.zh: [Kaffee] 而事情搞砸后，你就把这些人抛弃了！
cues.en: [Kaffee] And when it went bad, you cut these guys loose!

cues.zh: [Randolph] 到此为止，律师。[Kaffee] 而事情搞砸后，你就把这些人抛弃了！
cues.en: [Randolph] That will be all, Counsel. [Kaffee] And when it went bad, you cut these guys loose!

cues.zh: [Kaffee] 而事情搞砸后，你就把这些人抛弃了！
cues.en: [Kaffee] And when it went bad, you cut these guys loose!

cues.zh: [Ross] 法官大人！
cues.en: [Ross] Your Honor!

cues.zh: [Randolph] 律师，我要判你藐视法庭！[Kaffee] 你让马金森签了一份假的调职令！
cues.en: [Randolph] Counsel, I'll hold you in contempt! [Kaffee] You had Markinson sign a phony transfer order!

cues.zh: [Ross] 法官大人！[Kaffee] 你让Markinson签了一份伪造的调令！
cues.en: [Ross] YOUR HONOR! [Kaffee] You had Markinson sign a phony transfer order!

cues.zh: [Kaffee] 你篡改了日志！
cues.en: [Kaffee] You doctored the log book!

cues.zh: [Ross] 该死的，Kaffee！[Kaffee] 你胁迫了医生！我现在在问你！
cues.en: [Ross] DAMMIT, KAFFEE! [Kaffee] You coerced the doctor! Now I'm asking you!

cues.zh: [Kaffee] 你胁迫了医生！我现在在问你！
cues.en: [Kaffee] You coerced the doctor! Now I'm asking you!

cues.zh: [Randolph] 你藐视法庭！[Kaffee] 你胁迫了医生！我现在在问你！
cues.en: [Randolph] Consider yourself in contempt! [Kaffee] You coerced the doctor! Now I'm asking you!

cues.zh: JESSUP上校！是你下令执行红色代码的吗？！
cues.en: COLONEL JESSUP! DID YOU ORDER THE CODE RED?!

cues.zh: 你不必回答这个问题！
cues.en: You don't have to answer that question!

cues.zh: 我要回答这个问题。
cues.en: I'll answer the question.

cues.zh: 你想要答案？！
cues.en: You want answers?!

cues.zh: 我想我有权——
cues.en: I think I'm entitled to--

cues.zh: [Jessup] 你想要答案？！
cues.en: [Jessup] *You want answers*?!

cues.zh: 我要真相！
cues.en: I WANT THE TRUTH!

cues.zh: 你承受不了真相！
cues.en: *You can't handle the truth*!

cues.zh: 孩子，我们生活在一个有墙的世界里，而那些墙必须由持枪的人来守卫。
cues.en: Son, we live in a world that has walls, and those walls have to be guarded by men with guns.

cues.zh: 谁来干这事？你？你，Weinberg中尉？
cues.en: Who's gonna do it? You?(!) You, Lt. Weinberg?(!)

cues.zh: 我肩负的责任远超你所能想象！
cues.en: I have a greater responsibility than you can possibly fathom!

cues.zh: 你为圣地亚哥哭泣，还诅咒那些陆战队员。你有这个奢侈。
cues.en: You weep for Santiago and you curse the Marines. You have that luxury.

cues.zh: 你奢侈地不知道我所知道的事：圣地亚哥的死——虽然悲惨——*很可能*拯救了生命！
cues.en: You have the luxury of not knowing what I know: That Santiago's death - while tragic - *probably* saved lives!

cues.zh: 而我的存在——虽然在你看来怪诞又难以理解——*拯救了生命*！
cues.en: And my existence - while grotesque and incomprehensible to you - *saves lives*!

cues.zh: 你不想要真相，因为在你内心深处那些派对上从不谈论的地方……
cues.en: You don't want the truth, because deep down in places you don't talk about at parties...

cues.zh: 你*想要*我守在那堵墙上。你*需要*我守在那堵墙上。
cues.en: You *want* me on that wall. You *need* me on that wall.

cues.zh: 我们用“荣誉”、“准则”、“忠诚”这样的词。
cues.en: We use words like "honor", "code", "loyalty".

cues.zh: 我们把这些词当作一生*捍卫*某种东西的脊梁。
cues.en: We use this words as the backbone of a life spent *defending* something.

cues.zh: 你却把它们当笑柄！
cues.en: You use them as a punchline!

cues.zh: 我既没时间，也没兴趣解释我自己
cues.en: I have neither the time, nor the inclination to explain myself

cues.zh: 向一个靠我提供的自由遮风挡雨、起居作息的人
cues.en: to a man who rises and sleeps under the blanket of the very freedom that I provide

cues.zh: 然后还*质疑*我提供自由的方式！
cues.en: and then *questions* the manner in which I provide it!

cues.zh: 我宁愿你只说一句“谢谢”，然后走你的路。
cues.en: I would rather you just said "thank you", and went on your way.

cues.zh: 否则，我建议你拿起武器，站好你的岗。
cues.en: Otherwise, I suggest you pick up a weapon and stand a post.

cues.zh: *不管怎样，我根本不在乎你觉得自己有什么资格*！
cues.en: *Either way, I don't give a DAMN what you think you are entitled to*!

cues.zh: 你下令执行“红色代码”了吗？
cues.en: Did you order the code red?

cues.zh: [Jessup] 我做了我该做的——
cues.en: [Jessup] I did the job--

cues.zh: 你下令执行“红色代码”了吗？！
cues.en: DID YOU ORDER THE CODE RED?!

cues.zh: *你他妈说对了，就是我下的令*！！
cues.en: *YOU'RE GODDAMN RIGHT I DID*!!
